audit_items.proof_trace: All KZG coset shift calculations are implemented in the external c-kzg-4844 library (v2.1.1). Prysm's code contains only thin wrappers that delegate to ckzg4844.ComputeCells and related functions. No Prysm-specific implementation of coset shifts, bit-reversal permutations, or roots of unity exists. This property is out-of-scope for Prysm auditing as violations would be bugs in the external Ethereum Foundation library, not Prysm code.
